title: Was timing of Eagles ESPN piece a 'warning shot' to Jalen Hurts?

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Was timing of Eagles ESPN piece a 'warning shot' to Jalen Hurts?
sources.description: If the Eagles piece had dropped Monday instead of Wednesday, it would have been all over the league meetings. That suggests something to Pro Football Talk's Mike Florio, who appeared on Thursday's edition of "Yahoo Sports Daily."
